description.fun: Nidoran♂'s big ears can turn in any direction, so even the faintest sound doesn't escape it, and it flaps them like wings to listen far away. The bigger its horn, the stronger its venom. It's brave, too, and will risk its life to protect Nidoran♀; the two were the first Pokémon with genders, back when that made them separate species.
description.guide: A small, purple, male-only Poison Pokémon with large, movable ears, toxic spines and a poisonous horn. It listens constantly for danger and charges with its horn when angry. It is the male counterpart of Nidoran♀ and evolves into Nidorino.
description.tagline: All ears, all horn, and brave to a fault

description.fun: Nidorino's horn is harder than diamond, and the more worked up it gets, the stronger its poison. Hot-tempered and easily angered, it bristles all its barbs at once and charges anything hostile, and it smashes boulders looking for Moon Stones. With Gengar, it starred in the first Pokémon battle anyone saw, in the opening of Red and Green.
description.guide: The middle stage of the male Nidoran line, a purple, male-only Poison Pokémon with a diamond-hard horn that secretes poison. It is aggressive and quick to anger, charging foes with its barbs raised. It evolves into Nidoking with a Moon Stone.
description.tagline: A hothead with a horn harder than diamond

description.fun: Designed as a kaiju, Nidoking has a tail said to topple a metal transmission tower and a horn that can crush diamonds. Once it goes on a rampage it's impossible to control; only a Nidoqueen it has lived with for a long time can calm it down. It's a favourite of rivals in the anime, too, used by both Gary and Paul.
description.guide: The final stage of the male Nidoran line, a large Poison and Ground Pokémon with a venomous horn and a powerful tail. It is proud of its strength and becomes uncontrollable on a rampage. It evolves from Nidorino with a Moon Stone and is the counterpart of Nidoqueen.
description.tagline: A kaiju with a diamond-crushing horn and a soft spot for Nidoqueen
